data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 放学后道场的木剑对决
data.description: 放学后空荡的木地板剑术道场内，阿蕾克希亚单手持单手剑微喘，几缕银发贴在泛红的面颊上，红眸目光灼灼地迎视着对面的席德。
data.location: empty polished wooden dojo training hall in late afternoon
data.action: holding one-handed training sword lowered, breathing softly with glowing crimson eyes locked onto opponent, hair strands clinging to flushed skin
data.lighting: slanting golden sunset beams through dojo lattice windows
data.mood: intense swordplay camaraderie, prideful determination, hidden romantic tension
data.promptProse: In a sunlit wooden dojo, silver-haired ponytail Alexia lowers her training sword with panting breath and fierce red eyes.
data.animaCaption: Catching her breath after an intense sparring match in the dojo, a gentle flush warms her cheeks.
